examName: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AZ-700, 'Skills measured as of July 27, 2026'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Design and implement core networking infrastructure
subtopics: Plan and implement network segmentation, address spaces, and virtual networks
Plan and configure subnetting, subnet delegation, and shared or dedicated subnets
Create public IP addresses, public IP prefixes, and custom IP address prefixes
Design name resolution inside a virtual network and configure DNS settings
Design and configure public and private DNS zones and link a private zone to a virtual network
Design and implement Azure DNS Private Resolver
Design service chaining and gateway transit, and implement virtual network peering
Design and implement user-defined routes, route tables, and forced tunnelling
Design and implement Azure Route Server and Azure NAT Gateway
Configure monitoring, diagnostics, and logs with Network Watcher and Azure Monitor for Networks

domains.name: Design, implement, and manage connectivity services
subtopics: Design a site-to-site VPN including high availability and select a gateway SKU
Identify when to use a policy-based versus a route-based VPN connection
Create and configure local network gateways, virtual network gateways, and IPsec/IKE policies
Select a gateway SKU, tunnel type, and authentication method for point-to-site VPN
Configure RADIUS and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and implement a VPN client configuration
Select an ExpressRoute connectivity model, SKU, and tier
Implement ExpressRoute Global Reach, FastPath, and ExpressRoute Direct
Configure Azure private peering and Microsoft peering and connect a virtual network to a circuit
Configure encryption over ExpressRoute and implement Bidirectional Forwarding Detection
Design a Virtual WAN architecture, create virtual hubs, and configure hub routing

domains.name: Design and implement application delivery services
subtopics: Map requirements to Azure Load Balancer capabilities and choose a SKU and tier
Choose between public and internal, and between regional and cross-region load balancers
Create load balancing rules, inbound NAT rules, and explicit outbound rules including SNAT
Implement Azure Traffic Manager and Gateway Load Balancer
Identify appropriate use cases for Azure Application Gateway and choose manual or autoscale
Create backend pools, health probes, listeners, routing rules, and HTTP settings
Configure Transport Layer Security and rewrite rule sets on Application Gateway
Identify appropriate use cases for Azure Front Door and choose a tier
Configure Front Door routing, origins, endpoints, caching, and traffic acceleration
Configure TLS termination and end-to-end TLS, rules, URL rewrite and redirect, and secure an origin with Private Link

domains.name: Design and implement private access to Azure services
subtopics: Plan and create private endpoints and configure access to them
Create a Private Link service
Integrate Private Link and private endpoints with DNS
Integrate a Private Link service with on-premises clients
Choose when to use a service endpoint
Create service endpoints and configure access to them
Configure service endpoint policies

domains.name: Design and implement Azure network security services
subtopics: Create network security groups and associate them to subnets or network interfaces
Create application security groups and associate them to network interfaces
Create and configure inbound and outbound security rules
Implement and interpret virtual network flow logs and verify IP flow
Configure a network security group for remote server administration including Azure Bastion
Implement virtual network security using Azure Virtual Network Manager
Map requirements to Azure Firewall capabilities and select an appropriate SKU
Design and implement an Azure Firewall deployment and configure firewall rules
Create and implement Azure Firewall Manager policies and a secured virtual hub
Design a Web Application Firewall deployment, configure detection or prevention mode, and associate a WAF policy
